description: This file defines a class 'LeaveProfileNode' used within the Twig templating engine's profiling system. It represents a node that marks the 'leave' point in profiling, used to indicate the end of profiling a particular template segment.

classes.name: Twig\Profiler\Node\LeaveProfileNode
classes.description: Represents a profile leave node for Twig's profiling system, used to mark the end of profiling a particular segment.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a LeaveProfileNode with the given variable name used in profiling.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the node to PHP code, generating calls to the leave method of the profiler.
